description: This Java source file defines the class LoanInterestPauseStepDef, which contains step definitions for Cucumber tests related to interest pause functionality on loans within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to create interest pauses and verify failure scenarios.

classes.name: LoanInterestPauseStepDef
classes.description: A test step definition class for loan interest pause operations, extending AbstractStepDef, used in Cucumber BDD tests.

methods.name: interestPauseCreate
methods.description: Creates an interest pause period for a loan with specified start and end dates, verifying successful API call.

methods.name: createInterestPauseFailure
methods.description: Attempts to create an interest pause period expected to fail due to constraints such as loan type, verifying error response.

methods.name: createInterestPauseForInactiveLoanFailure
methods.description: Attempts to create an interest pause on an inactive loan, expecting a failure response.
